Peer-graded Assignment: Getting and Cleaning Data Course Project 
This repository is a submission for Getting and Cleaning Data course project. 
It contains the instructions on how to run analysis on Human Activity recognition dataset.

Dataset
Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones (UCI_HAR_Dataset)

Files
CodeBook.md a code book that describes the variables, the data, and any transformations or work that I performed to clean up the data

run_analysis.R performs the data preparation and the steps required in the course project’s definition:

1. Downloads the datasets and assigns each data to variables

2. Assigns each data to variables

3. Merges the training and the test sets

4. Extracts mean and standard deviation for each measurement

5. Uses descriptive activity names to name the activities in the data set

6. Labels the data set with descriptive variable names

7. Creates a tidy data set with the average of each variable/activity/subject and exports it in the FinalData.txt.
